get_camera_pose: get the camera pose matrix with optional rotation applied for the robot head
get_pose_in_base_coords: get the camera pose in base coordinates using tf for grasp computation
set_pan_tilt: set the head pan and tilt joint angles with optional blocking behavior
get_images: get RGB and depth images from the robot camera with optional XYZ point cloud
depth_to_xyz: convert a depth image array to XYZ 3D coordinates using camera intrinsics
